data.gender_notes: Nashrah is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Nashrah is a soft-spoken and gentle name in Islamic tradition. It is derived from the Arabic word 'nashr' which means to spread, or to open up. This name signifies one who is graceful and has a charming personality. The name Nashrah carries the meaning “Soft-spoken” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in English, Urdu, Hindi. Parents who choose Nashrah usually hope their child will grow to embody soft-spoken and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A gentle soul with a graceful presence.
data.etymology: Nashrah belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Soft-spoken.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Nashrah total 6, giving a life-path number of 6. Number 6 is linked with Venus and with the qualities of responsibility, care and community.
